Services

✓

Carpet Cleaning

The Cleaning Solutions is revolutionizing the carpet cleaning industry by offering both steam and dry cleaning options to residents in Charlotte Metro and Triad areas. Our tailored approach ensures the ideal cleaning method for your specific carpet needs, restoring its appearance and freshness. To enhance the durability and cleanliness of your carpets, we recommend our Scotchgard™ Carpet Treatment, which provides triple-action protection against spills, dirt, and stains.

✓

Upholstery Cleaning

Revitalize your furniture with The Cleaning Solutions, offering exceptional upholstery cleaning services to residents in Charlotte, Concord, Greensboro, Kernersville, Mooresville, and Winston-Salem, NC. Our skilled technicians thoroughly clean your furniture to eliminate allergens, dirt, and other debris, restoring the look and feel of your upholstery.

✓

Tile Cleaning

Rejuvenate your tile surfaces with The Cleaning Solutions' experienced tile cleaning services. Our seasoned professionals utilize state-of-the-art equipment and techniques to remove embedded dirt, grime, and other impurities, restoring your tiles to their original shine.

✓

Emergency Water Extraction

When disaster strikes, The Cleaning Solutions is here to help with our reliable emergency water extraction services. Our skilled technicians promptly remove excess water and employ a dry process to prevent the growth of harmful mold.

✓

Carpet Repair

The Cleaning Solutions offers exceptional carpet repair services to restore the beauty and functionality of your flooring, repairing frayed edges, ripped seams, and stubborn stains. Contact us today for a comprehensive carpet repair consultation.

✓

Car Interior Cleaning

Treat your vehicle to a deep cleaning with The Cleaning Solutions' comprehensive car interior cleaning services. Our team uses advanced techniques and eco-friendly products to remove dirt, stains, and odors from every surface of your car.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer both steam and dry carpet cleaning in Charlotte and the Triad?

Yes! The Cleaning Solutions offers tailored steam extraction and quick-dry carpet cleaning options for residential and commercial spaces across Winston-Salem, Greensboro, Kernersville, Charlotte, Concord, and Mooresville.

Are your cleaning formulas safe for pets and children?

Absolutely. We use safe, eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning formulas specifically engineered to eliminate tough pet stains and deep odors while remaining 100% safe for kids and pets.

How quickly can I get an estimate or book service?

Instant phone estimates are available! Click any quote button on the site to call our Triad line at (336) 975-8540 or our Charlotte line at (704) 772-5566 for immediate scheduling.

Do you handle emergency water extraction?

Yes. Our rapid response team provides emergency water extraction and thorough dry-out procedures to prevent mold and restore your flooring promptly.
